description: Shared vectors of Words (Ruby and JS), skeleton of W2-0: the cases below are certain; the track T3 adds the rest (including the mutants of a wrong answer) before it builds the functions. 'args' are strings as the schema holds them; 'result' is the canonical output.

split.doc: A form in split notation as pieces with their marks; the marks removed give the word.

syllables_es.doc: The syllables of a Spanish word.

stress_es.doc: The 1-based index of the stressed syllable.

tilde_ok.doc: Whether the written tilde (or its absence) follows the stress rule.

present.doc: W2-2: the six present forms by pattern; spanish/verbs is the truth and the engine only cross-checks regular and stem-changing rows.
